About Dr. Husseini

A precise hand, a calm chair.

Careful diagnosis, unhurried appointments, and every treatment explained before it begins.

Background

Dr. Jihad S. Husseini practises cosmetic dentistry, endodontics, and prosthetic and implant dentistry. Having all three under one roof means a case that starts as a cosmetic consultation can continue as root canal therapy or an implant without a referral — the same hand, and the same plan, from start to finish.

Treatment philosophy

Every treatment begins with a diagnosis you can see for yourself and a plan in plain language: what it involves, what it costs, and what the alternatives are. Comfort is part of that plan rather than an afterthought.

Areas of practice

  • Cosmetic dentistry — veneers, whitening, and smile design
  • Endodontics — root canal therapy and retreatment
  • Prosthetic and implant dentistry — crowns, bridges, and implants

Why patients choose this practice

Three specialties under one roof — no referrals, no delays.

Modern diagnostics and a precision-first approach to every treatment.

A calm, unhurried practice built around your comfort.
